entities.name: UniProt Q69NF5
observations: Exact 515-aa query sequence match to reviewed Oryza sativa endoglucanase 23 (100% identity and coverage).
Annotated as secreted; GO includes extracellular region, cellulase activity, and carbohydrate metabolic process.
Pfam Glyco_hydro_9 (PF00759) detected at residues 42–499; supports glycoside hydrolase family 9 classification.

observations: Homolog of rice endoglucanase 23: 63.5% identity and 90.7% query coverage; annotated with cellulase activity, secreted localization, carbohydrate metabolism, and plant cell-wall loosening-related processes.
